title: 逆転裁判
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written

The table: the words of pages the game was showing, beside the characters read off the screen; kana not met are filled in by the order every kana met keeps. No second reader has read it, and no font was read
Played from power-on through the first episode's opening. What the script said in play agreed with the rows read off 61 of 61 pictures, over 4 scenes. No screen without text was among them
The same readings built the table, so the comparison checks pages and their order more than it checks the characters
notes: Read by the script games/gba/AGB-ASBJ.lua. A scene's script lies unpacked in the 256 KB on the board; a word in the CPU's 32 KB says where it has got to. A page is said when that stands on a wait. The table has 277 characters: other kanji come out as U+FFFD. Who speaks is given as the script's number for the speaker only: the name on the window's tab is a picture. Not looked at: choices, the court record, cross-examination, saved games. The id AGB-ASBJ is the cartridge's code with the console's prefix.
